title: FRAGMENT: Factorized Graph Representations for Document Generation and Editing via Entity-Aware Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2608.18679v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structured documents such as invoices, forms, reports, and scientific articles derive meaning from the interplay between spatial layout, textual content, and logical structure. Generative models operating at the pixel or token level often struggle to capture these dependencies effectively. We explore FRAGMENT, a generative framework that represents a document as a typed relational graph and factorizes its distribution as p(structure, content) = p(structure) * p(content | structure). The framework consists of two stages. The first stage, the Architect, is a causally masked Transformer conditioned on document category that autoregressively generates the graph topology and typed spatial relations. The second stage, the Builder, is a GATv2-based graph attention network that enriches the graph with normalized bounding boxes, text, and visual style attributes. Both stages define explicit likelihood models, yielding a tractable document-level

translated_title: FRAGMENT：基于实体感知变换的因子化图表示用于文档生成与编辑
translated_abstract: 诸如发票、表单、报告和科学文章等结构化文档，其意义源自空间布局、文本内容和逻辑结构之间的相互作用。在像素或词元级别运行的生成模型往往难以有效捕捉这些依赖关系。我们探索了FRAGMENT，这是一个生成式框架，它将文档表示为类型化关系图，并将其分布分解为 p(structure, content) = p(structure) × p(content | structure)。该框架由两个阶段组成。第一阶段是Architect（架构师），这是一个以文档类别为条件的因果掩码Transformer，自回归地生成图拓扑结构和类型化空间关系。第二阶段是Builder（构建器），这是一个基于GATv2的图注意力网络，用归一化的边界框、文本和视觉样式属性来丰富图。两个阶段均定义了显式的似然模型，从而产生可处理的文档级（似然）……
tldr: 提出FRAGMENT框架，将结构化文档表示为类型化关系图，通过“架构师”（生成图拓扑与空间关系）和“构建器”（填充边界框、文本与视觉样式）两阶段因子化建模，实现了具有可处理似然的文档生成与编辑。
en_tdlr: FRAGMENT represents documents as typed relational graphs and factorizes generation into an Architect stage for graph topology and spatial relations and a Builder stage for content and style, yielding tractable document-level likelihoods for generation and editing.
